_about: Complex junctions tools/earth_eval.py draws before and after an Earth change (no regressions). A junction: name, what (why it is here), at (lat, lon) or xy (m in the anchor's frame), anchor (lat, lon; default: the point rounded to 0.01 deg), aid (default 9), q (the anchor's height quantum; default 1/32), radius (m; default 40), geometry (EarthRally stage lines drawn over it, repo paths).
